| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deletionPolicy` | string |  | `Orphan` keeps the external resource when the managed resource is deleted. Without `Delete` in `managementPolicies` the resource is always orphaned. One of `Delete`, `Orphan`. Default `Delete`. |
| `forProvider` | object | yes | `spec.forProvider`: the generated API fields plus references and credentials. |
| `forProvider.address` | string | yes | The hostname or IP address of the origin server to run health checks on. |
| `forProvider.check_regions` | []string |  | A list of regions from which to run health checks. Null means Cloudflare will pick a default region. |
| `forProvider.consecutive_fails` | integer (int64) |  | The number of consecutive fails required from a health check before changing the health to unhealthy. |
| `forProvider.consecutive_successes` | integer (int64) |  | The number of consecutive successes required from a health check before changing the health to healthy. |
| `forProvider.description` | string |  | A human-readable description of the health check. |
| `forProvider.http_config` | object |  | Parameters specific to an HTTP or HTTPS health check. |
| `forProvider.http_config.allow_insecure` | boolean |  | Do not validate the certificate when the health check uses HTTPS. Default `false`. |
| `forProvider.http_config.expected_body` | string |  | A case-insensitive sub-string to look for in the response body. If this string is not found, the origin will be marked as unhealthy. Default ``. |
| `forProvider.http_config.expected_codes` | []string |  | The expected HTTP response codes (e.g. "200") or code ranges (e.g. "2xx" for all codes starting with 2) of the health check. |
| `forProvider.http_config.follow_redirects` | boolean |  | Follow redirects if the origin returns a 3xx status code. Default `false`. |
| `forProvider.http_config.header` | map[string][]string |  | The HTTP request headers to send in the health check. It is recommended you set a Host header by default. The User-Agent header cannot be overridden. |
| `forProvider.http_config.method` | string |  | The HTTP method to use for the health check. One of `GET`, `HEAD`. Default `GET`. |
| `forProvider.http_config.path` | string |  | The endpoint path to health check against. Default `/`. |
| `forProvider.http_config.port` | integer (int64) |  | Port number to connect to for the health check. Defaults to 80 if type is HTTP or 443 if type is HTTPS. Default `80`. |
| `forProvider.interval` | integer (int64) |  | The interval between each health check. Shorter intervals may give quicker notifications if the origin status changes, but will increase load on the origin as we check from multiple locations. |
| `forProvider.name` | string | yes | A short name to identify the health check. Only alphanumeric characters, hyphens and underscores are allowed. |
| `forProvider.retries` | integer (int64) |  | The number of retries to attempt in case of a timeout before marking the origin as unhealthy. Retries are attempted immediately. |
| `forProvider.suspended` | boolean |  | If suspended, no health checks are sent to the origin. |
| `forProvider.tcp_config` | object |  | Parameters specific to TCP health check. |
| `forProvider.tcp_config.method` | string |  | The TCP connection method to use for the health check. One of `connection_established`. Default `connection_established`. |
| `forProvider.tcp_config.port` | integer (int64) |  | Port number to connect to for the health check. Defaults to 80. Default `80`. |
| `forProvider.timeout` | integer (int64) |  | The timeout (in seconds) before marking the health check as failed. |
| `forProvider.type` | string |  | The protocol to use for the health check. Currently supported protocols are 'HTTP', 'HTTPS' and 'TCP'. |
| `forProvider.zoneRef` | object |  | A reference to another managed resource: a namespaced resource in the namespace of the resource holding the reference, or a cluster-scoped one. |
| `forProvider.zoneRef.name` | string | yes |  |
| `managementPolicies` | []string |  | Actions the controller may take. `["*"]` (default) allows all; `["Observe"]` only reads (import without management). `Observe` is always required. Default `["*"]`. |
